scenarios.source: ANUGA (Geoscience Australia / ANU, GPL) on GEM-15 (experimental) DTM, Google Research, CC-BY 4.0 (gaps: NASADEM); ESA WorldCover 2021; OpenStreetMap
scenarios.method: ANUGA 4.2.0 2D shallow-water (DE0) on Reach 1 (dam → Medjerda confluence + 2 km, 112 km², 69616 triangles, ≤ 2500 m² everywhere). DEM: GEM-15 (experimental) bare-earth DTM 15 m block-averaged to 30 m, flow-path cells lowered 2 m. Manning n from ESA WorldCover. Triangular release hydrograph at the dam outlet: V = 21 Mm³ over 12 h, peak 972 m³/s at 0.3 D (scenario values, not measurements). Dry start, free outflow at the downstream face, 48 h simulated. Wet = max depth > 0.1 m. maxdepth/frames: uint8, depth = value/255 × 8 m; arrival.png: 0 = not reached, else hours = value × 0.2. Frames every 60 min.
scenarios.uncertainty: Scenario exploration, not a forecast. 30 m terrain without channel bathymetry: the river channel is narrower than a mesh triangle, so depths, speeds and arrival times are indicative only; the release hydrograph shape and duration are assumptions; no calibration data (no gauge, no surveyed flood marks). Mass balance error 0.000% of V. Reach 2 (Medjerda to Sidi Salem) is not modelled.
